Each enlarged emblem is paired with a 48 px preview and the same worn-ink treatment used in the passport. Download the transparent WebP from each card, exactly as the passport ships it.

Flags are the app's own: Twemoji, named by country code. Northern Cyprus and Somaliland, which Twemoji lacks, are drawn in the same style; the Siachen Glacier, which has no flag of its own, carries a plain white one. Names and grouping follow the app's catalogue.

Standalone review copy. All artwork and flags are embedded; this page works offline and is not linked from TravelMap.
